verdict.rationale: Docs mention OFAC/KYT screening to block sanctioned/high-risk payments and batch-settlement escrow/refund semantics ('buyers retain defined refund and withdrawal semantics'), which touch on risk allocation, but there is no consolidated merchant-facing documentation of fraud liability, chargeback rules, or who bears loss in disputed/agent-initiated transactions. Missing for 10: explicit chargeback/dispute policy, liability allocation between buyer/seller/facilitator, fraud reimbursement terms, and independent confirmation these screening/escrow mechanisms actually shift risk in practice.
